correctness.rationale: Rebuilt L(Q3) from the 12 cube edges and found 24 adjacency edges. Discrete two-particle cubical model has 66 vertices, 240 edge-vertex cells, 204 disjoint-edge squares; independent boundary calculations checked d1*d2=0, d1 rank 65 and d2 rank 161 over F_2,F_3,F_101,F_1009. Independently decoded actual 24,241-byte certificate and recomputed the 161x161 integer minor by exact fraction-free elimination: determinant +1; checked 43 kernel columns satisfy B*K=0 and 43x43 pivot inverse. Thus H1=Z^14 and H2=Z^43, with no torsion. Reconstructed signed actions of all 48 cube symmetries on cells and kernel; reproduced ten rational character values in both degrees and S4xC2 irreducible multiplicities. The graph is sufficiently subdivided for n=2 (one edge between essential vertices, simple cycle lengths >=3).

originality.rationale: Barnett–Farber Theorem 6.1 strongly covers integral H2 of ordered configurations for ALL planar graphs by disjoint face-pair tori, with swap involution; other general graph braid papers supply cellular equivariant machinery. These are credited. The final claimed result is not the ranks or general existence of representation, but the full ten-conjugacy-class rational Aut(L(Q3)) character and all multiplicities, plus a reproducible integral unit-minor certificate. This specialized 48-element signed action is NOT tabulated by the general planar theorem and requires new graph-specific enumeration/certificate. Resultary closest SCOPE entries concern Petersen/dodecahedral configurations and exchange-sign Borel–Moore homology, distinct objects/coefficients. It remains a computational corollary of general theory, so originality scope is narrow; no exact table found.
residual_risks: General planar face-pair basis substantially implies H2 structure; the scientific novelty is strictly the explicit specialized full automorphism character, and treating raw Betti ranks as new would be incorrect.
A different indexed graph-braid computation or a specialized character table might already supply the exact graph data; no exhaustive literature guarantee.

The evaluated source certificate is a particular exact lattice basis; independent verification of its integer determinant and 48-character action supports correctness but does not independently establish originality.
